title: Free online space game
author: valle_create
selftext:
I’ve been working full-time as a solo dev for the past year, building Nova Warp with Claude Code and my own ComfyUI workflows. It’s a free-to-play, online, top-down space game.

Grab your friends, choose your roles, combine your abilities and loadouts, and explore Nova Warp’s open sector system together. Fight the creatures of space, take on dungeons and raids, and team up in a clan to battle other players.

Play for free on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4843280/Nova_Warp/) or visit [nova-warp.com](https://nova-warp.com).

Type `/redeem welcome` in chat to claim a little starter pack of resources! :)

comments.author: MosesSecondofHisName
comments.body: Looks good! How did you set up the online multiplayer?

replies.author: valle_create
replies.body: The server runs headless Godot instances on Hetzner, with all clients connecting to it. The detailed setup was also created by Claude
